item.title: Model Context Protocol Docs
item.description:
The official home for the Model Context Protocol specification: how the handshake works, how tools and resources are defined, and reference documentation for building both clients and servers.

Start here if you want to understand MCP at the protocol level rather than just using pre-built servers from the directory.

item.title: Doc Co-Authoring
item.description: Doc Co-Authoring packages a structured process for writing technical specs, PRDs, decision docs, and proposals: gathering context up front, iteratively building sections through brainstorming and editing, then stress-testing the draft by having a fresh, context-free Claude read it as a real reader would.

item.title: Context7
item.description: Context7 resolves a library name (like “Next.js” or “shadcn/ui”) to a version-specific ID, then pulls current documentation and code snippets straight from the source into an agent’s prompt. It works with no signup for basic usage, with a free API key available for higher rate limits.
